text:
[LEXP.9.5.1] `t.dwell` is a compile-time alias for the time `t`'s fact has
been in working memory: `monotonic_ns()` minus the fact's entry stamp
([LTIM.2.8.6]), a `Duration`. `t` is a `logical`-schema binding. It composes
with arithmetic. It reads no slot of the fact — `ts` included — so neither an
adapter's timestamp nor a wall-clock change moves it.

idris.name: Ltim_2_4_1__read
idris.note: `t.dwell` as the leaf `ReadDwell b`, `b` the rank of `t`'s fact in the extended token: the alias the clause names, carried into the `where` grammar; what it reads is Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's `ltim_2_4_1__read_at`.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_leaf
idris.note: THE `dwell` LEAF IS THE SAMPLE LESS THE STAMP: for a fact the token holds and the table stamps, `ltim_2_4_1__at_sample` replaces `t.dwell` by TwoClocks.idr's `lexp_9_5_1__dwell` at the sample and that stamp. A TRANSCRIPTION of `ltim_2_4_1__read_at`'s third clause, said so: it fails if the leaf is changed to read a slot or the wall and refutes nothing else.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_of_head
idris.note: `t.dwell` of the single positive pattern's fact: the leaf at rank 0. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__read_at
idris.note: `t.dwell` is `monotonic_ns()` minus the fact's entry stamp: TwoClocks.idr's `lexp_9_5_1__dwell` at the sample and the stamp read off the table, as an Int of clock units; it reads no slot of the fact, `ts` included. LESS than the clause: a `Duration` in nanoseconds is the fixture lowering's scaling by the time map's unit, and `t` a `logical` binding is its refusal (`where:dwell-schema`); the leaf reads any rank's stamp. A fact the token does not hold, or one with no stamp, reads `null`, which no positive node admits.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__due_stamped
idris.note: `dwell >= d` over the stamp table, as the gate the theorems take. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__guard_expr
idris.note: `t.dwell` of the timer, the monotonic sample less its entry stamp, against the duration. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__guard_forms_agree
idris.note: `dwell >= d` evaluated by the Integer order and by the Nat gate, decided alike at two samples. Computed; run, not proved on variables.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__guard_is_due
idris.note: `dwell >= d` from a stamp is `monotonic_ns() >= stamp + d`, for every stamp, positive duration and sample.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_at
idris.note: '`monotonic_ns()` minus the fact's entry stamp', compared with `d`, at one sample over the stamp table.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_fires_once_executed
idris.note: The one rule under `dwell >= 2` fires once, at the sample where `dwell` reaches 2, and never again. Executed.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_gate
idris.note: `dwell >= d` as a two-clock test reading the monotonic sample alone.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_gate_b
idris.note: `dwell >= d` for a fixed stamp, as a predicate of the monotonic clock.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_gate_monotonic
idris.note: 'Neither an adapter's timestamp nor a wall-clock change moves it': a TRANSCRIPTION by construction on the monotonic component.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_gate_rising
idris.note: `dwell` only grows while the stamp stands, so a `dwell >= d` gate is rising.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_ignores_wall_executed
idris.note: 'Nor a wall-clock change moves it', executed: the same counts with the wall going 1, 2, 1, 2 and with every wall sample 9.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_start
idris.note: The one rule under `dwell >= 2`, the `Ping` stamped at 0. A fixture.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_tests_monotonic
idris.note: The `dwell` test is monotonic at every stamp table: C2's hypothesis, inhabited.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_2__wall_steps_move_no_dwell_timed
idris.note: 'Neither an adapter's timestamp nor a wall-clock change moves it': the stamp is read, the wall is not. Executed.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell
idris.note: `dwell`: the monotonic sample less the fact's entry stamp ([LTIM.2.8.6]). Reduced to its clock dependence; the stamp's lifecycle is Rete/EntryStamp.idr's.
